claims.statement: In the stated two-type linear branching model, the probability of no post-pulse establishment obeys the backward PGF ODE in FINAL_REPORT.md, and the initial derivative is q_R[(d_R-b_R)+b_R q_R]-nu(q_E-q_R).
claims.status: internally derived exact conditional theorem; branching PGF method is established
claims.novelty_boundary: No novelty claim. Time-inhomogeneous multitype branching and cancer phenotype-switching extinction models pre-exist.
claims.costs: Requires event-resolved births, deaths, switching, absolute founders, post-pulse establishment assays, and a valid lineage observation model.
claims.falsifier: Held-out lineage-risk data fall outside the frozen model prediction interval or an untracked type contributes relapse.
claims.next_gate: Blinded barcode-resolved validation against equally informed treatment controls.

claims.novelty_boundary: An application-specific identifiability witness, not a new branching-process principle.
claims.costs: Mean-only follow-up cannot resolve it; event-level birth/death and state-transition observation is needed.
claims.falsifier: The derivative calculations fail under the declared rates or a direct event-resolved assay identifies the two pulse models as having different measured observables.
claims.next_gate: Measure event-level hazards and validate the full finite-duration prediction.
